sources.snippet: MathT5-base is a version of T5-base (not FLAN-T5) that is fine-tuned for 25 epochs on 15K (LaTeX) synthetic mathematical derivations (containing 4 - 10 equations), that were generated using a symbolic solver (SymPy).
